scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street scene at night with a large crowd of people walking along the sidewalk in front of a white building with ornate windows and balconies. The street is paved with asphalt and has a few cracks. There are several trees lining the sidewalk, some of which have lost their leaves. A few people are sitting on benches, while others are walking along the sidewalk. In the distance, there are more buildings and a dark blue sky with clouds. The street is well-lit by streetlights and building lights. The atmosphere is lively and bustling with people going about their evening activities.
scene_analysis.buildings: The white building has a mix of modern and traditional elements, with a curved facade featuring arched windows and balconies. It has three stories, with the top floor being mostly obscured by the second story. The ground floor has large windows and doors, while the third floor has smaller windows. The building is made of stone and has a decorative cornice along the roofline. The building is well-maintained, but shows signs of wear and tear. The surrounding buildings are also well-maintained, with a mix of old and new architecture. The area is densely populated, with many people walking along the sidewalk.
